handoff.text: REVIEW-9.md T318 findings. 1. README.md:15 'Open beside button on any sidebar row' is false (sources w/o PDF, notes, Bibliography): replace with '- **Open beside.** A section, a fragment or a source's PDF opens in a second pane from the **Open beside** button on its sidebar row, from its right-click menu, or with Cmd+click.' 2. README.md:61 'The only network use is a citation lookup' (Zotero refresh calls 127.0.0.1:23119): replace with '- **Local only.** No account, no subscription, no cloud. The only time it reaches the internet is a citation lookup; the optional Zotero refresh talks only to Zotero on the same Mac.' 3. low README.md:40 -> '- **Appearance.** System, Light or Dark; Cmd+Shift+L switches between Light and Dark.' 4. low README.md:17 -> '- **A fragment beside a section.** A fragment opens next to the section being written, ready to copy back.' 5. tests/readme-shots.spec.ts:141-154 delete the Colour… branch; use menu.getByRole('group',{name:'Colour',exact:true}).getByRole('menuitemradio',{name:colour,exact:true}).click() then expect(menu).toHaveCount(0); fix stale comments :9-10 and :277. Keep customise-light as Settings. Everything else (intro unchanged, sections, links, images, pronouns, caveats, demo content) passes.
